name: Borobudur Temple Compounds
description: Rising from the fertile Kedu Plain in central Java, about 40 km northwest of Yogyakarta, Borobudur is a vast Buddhist monument built in the 8th and 9th centuries. Its square terraces climb to circular platforms holding 72 latticed stupas, each sheltering a seated Buddha, beneath a great stupa at the summit. Carved relief panels cover some 2,500 square metres of its walls.
